## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 🧩 New component (adds a completely new UI component)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update (updates to docs, README, or JSDocs)
- [ ] 🎨 Design tokens or CSS styling update
- [ ] ⚙️ Tooling / CI / Infrastructure

## Affected Packages

- [ ] `@nova-ui/tokens`
- [ ] `@nova-ui/styles`
- [ ] `@nova-ui/core`

## Component Checklist (if adding or modifying components)

- [ ] Component complies with WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility guidelines
- [ ] Correct ARIA roles, states, and attributes are applied
- [ ] Keyboard navigation is fully supported (Tab, Enter/Space, Esc, Arrows)
- [ ] Styles leverage CSS cascade layers (`@layer nova.components`) and tokens
- [ ] Component is exported in the public package barrel (`index.ts`)
- [ ] Demo / documentation has been updated with interactive examples
- [ ] A Changeset has been added via `npm run changeset` (if publishing changes)
